text: Meeɗaali ka hoɗo ngo Men Nuli e mun Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen gomɗinta gomɗinal nafayngal ɓaawo yi'ugol lepte ɗen, gomɗinal maɓɓe nafa ontuma si wanaa yimɓe Yuunusa ɓen: nde ɓe gomɗinnoo gomɗinal goonga, Men huncanno ɓe lepte koyeera e jaasere ɗen ka nguurndam aduna, Men dakmiti ɓe haa e saanga timmugol laje maɓɓe ɗen.
